messages:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT: Heliotrope VPC tenant (tenant_id=heliotrope) alert triggered — model degradation detected on dedicated pool dp-helio-1. Symptoms: increased p99 latency, increased 5xx, kv_cache_fetch_timeout errors. Paging @oncall-sre :rotating_light:
oncall-sre: Ack. I'm on it. Paging @ashwin and @maya for customer-facing mitigation. Quick status: is this GPU OOM or cache thrash?
ashwin: digging into node logs — seeing KV cache thrash and intermittent OOMs on nodes 10-12 in dp-helio-1. Error snippet: `ERROR kv_cache_fetch_timeout tenant=heliotrope shard=11`. No host disk pressure.
maya: Customer (Alex @ Heliotrope) reporting hallucinations + 502s in prod. Support ticket #7592 opened. Important: customer cannot route to public hosted due to compliance (VPC-only). Need tenant-isolated mitigation — no cross-tenant fallbacks.
oncall-sre: Understood. Proposed immediate mitigation: pin tenant to a safe variant (quantized/smaller) AND route traffic to a warm standby in the dedicated fleet. Safe variants we can use: `redwood/gpt-large-v2-quant8-safe` or `redwood/gpt-medium-q4a-safe`. Given tail latency concerns, prefer pin to medium safe to reduce memory and tail. Thoughts?
ashwin: Agree with medium safe. Applying tenant override now. Command I'll run:
```
rctl tenant-override set --tenant heliotrope --model redwood/gpt-medium-q4a-safe --reason "mitigation: kv OOMs / p99 tail"
```
Also enabling routing to dedicated-standby-helio. Will post CR when done.
ops-bot: auto: created change request CR-20012 (tenant-override) and notified dedicated-infra. Approving immediate execution.
jiwoo: infra here — allocating warm nodes in us-west2 pool dedicated-standby-helio. Warm allocation ETA ~6m, full routing switch ~7m once placement completes. Will stream node-level metrics.
oncall-sre: Maya — can you notify the customer and give a short sample curl they can run to validate the pinned model? Keep message concise and mention NO cross-VPC egress.
maya: Messaging support and pinged Alex (alex@heliotrope). They've accepted temporary pin as long as we provide rollback criteria and ETA. Sending sample QA curl: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer \
  -d '{"tenant":"heliotrope","model":"redwood/gpt-medium-q4a-safe","input":"<sample>"}'
```
ashwin: Rollback criteria: p99 latency < 400ms AND kv_cache_fetch_timeout error rate < 0.1% over a continuous 10m window. Rollback command: 
```
rctl tenant-override remove --tenant heliotrope --reason "stable signals"
```
jiwoo: Warm nodes coming up. Observed initial OOMs drop as we rebalance KV shards. Early telemetry: p99 latency dropping from ~1800ms -> ~430ms within first 2m after routing change. Continuing to monitor.
oncall-sre: Great. Amanda from PS, can you prepare a short customer-facing summary for the call? We should include mitigation, ETA, and next steps (postmortem + capacity options).
amanda-ps: Drafting now. I'll send to Alex and propose a 30m check-in to discuss reserved capacity / quantization strategy. Also adding note about long-term: consider persistent tenant pin or increased reserved capacity if they need consistent latency.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated (partial). severity=SEV-2. affected=Heliotrope (dp-helio-1 dedicated). CR=CR-20012 applied.
oncall-sre: Assigning owners for follow-ups: Ashwin — RCA lead (KV cache churn analysis); Jiwoo — infra metrics and capacity recommendations; Maya — customer comms and support ticket closure. I'll close the active page but remain monitoring for 1h.
ashwin: :thumbsup: I'll collect KV cache churn graphs, config diffs, and the runcmd audit for overrides. Creating internal RCA doc under /incidents/2001234567-helio-rca-draft for handoff.
maya: Confirmed Alex received note and accepted pin. Support ticket updated with rollback criteria and estimated timeline.
oncall-sre: Thanks team. Logging action items: 1) postmortem within 48h, 2) consider tenant-specific autoscale improvements or reserve uplift, 3) revisit default fallback policy to prefer safe-variant pin before cross-tenant fallbacks for VPC tenants.
incidents-bot: RECORD: incident_closed_by=oncall-sre, closed_at=2001234699, severity=SEV-2, notes="temporary tenant pin to medium safe variant; warm standby routing applied; monitoring"
_comment: Generated Slack thread for Heliotrope tenant pin/fallback coordination
